notes: The rule that requires method docs is not in .rubocop.yml itself but in the inherited config/rubocop/base.yml (Style/DocumentationMethod). A good solution documents the class and every public method (initialize is not required) as the existing PointsLedger does, with comments that add information, and leaves private helpers undocumented. Circumvention: editing either config file, rubocop:disable, or :nodoc:.
